notes: Token positions (pos) are the same as in hero-trace.json (checked against its token ids). The answer's first digit '8' is pos 331 (logitLens 'answer-digit') and the reply's ' flour' is pos 336 (logitLens 'reply-word').

wordMap: 41 words in 6 groups, each ONE Qwen token with its leading space (tokenizer.encode(' ' + word)). No substitutions were needed: every suggested word is a single token. Number words stand in for numbers because Qwen splits every digit into its own token.

wordMap x/y: the raw input-embedding rows are L2-normalized and centered; PCA is run on the 6 group CENTROIDS (each group weighted equally, not the words), giving 5 axes (centroid singular values 0.604, 0.502, 0.457, 0.440, 0.426). Every pair of those axes was tried; each word is projected onto the pair and each axis min-max scaled to [-1, 1]. The pair kept, axes 2 and 4, has the highest same-group-nearest rate on the scaled map (100%; ties broken by the between/within-group variance ratio, 19.58). Axes 1 and 2 would give 85%; plain 2-D PCA of the words 46%. It is a linear projection of the real vectors.

wordMap.sameGroupNearest: the fraction of the 41 words whose single nearest OTHER map word is in the same group. 'full' uses cosine similarity on the full 896-number rows (0.951); 'map' uses straight-line distance on the displayed 2-D x/y (1.000).

wordMap.words[].neighbors: the 5 nearest OTHER map words by cosine similarity of the raw 896-number input-embedding rows, rounded to 3 decimals. strip: base64 of 896 signed bytes (int8): the raw row divided by its largest |value| and multiplied by 127, rounded (decode with Int8Array; the scale is not stored).

wordMap.table: the embedding table's shape, and the raw rows for the five ids centered on ' flour' (id 19828): each with its decoded token, its first four numbers rounded to 3 decimals, and a strip scaled so the largest |value| is 127. Neighbouring ids are unrelated tokens.

wordMap.flourNeighbors: cosine similarity of ' flour' (id 19828) against all 151665 real vocab rows (the unused padding rows beyond the tokenizer are excluded), highest first, keeping only tokens whose text is a leading space + ASCII letters (regex '^ [A-Za-z]+$') and dropping ' flour' itself. The 10 kept are the readable ones among the top 16 rows.

breaks: every run starts from the same context, hero tokens 0..326: everything through the generation prompt '<|im_start|>assistant\n' after </tool_response>, where the model's second turn (the reply) begins. text = PURE greedy generation: argmax over the 151665 real vocab rows (padding rows excluded) with no repetition penalty, top-k, top-p or temperature; at most 40 new tokens; stops at <|im_end|> or <|endoftext|> (Qwen's two EOS ids; stoppedNaturally = true), and the stop token is not counted in tokenCount. text is decoded with skip_special_tokens=True. Every step recomputes the whole sequence (no KV cache), so the sabotage applies to every position, including generated tokens as they are fed back. The 'normal' text matches phase1.json's T=0 reply (which used a KV cache).

breaks[].rightDigit: one teacher-forced pass over hero tokens 0..343 (the context plus the 17 RECORDED reply tokens 'You need about 8.4 cups of flour to feed 30 people.', not the variant's own reply) under the same sabotage. prob = P('8') for pos 331, read from the hidden state at pos 330, softmax at T=1 over the 151665 real vocab rows; top = the 3 most likely tokens there. Normal run: 0.9951 (hero-trace.json, softmax over all 151936 rows incl. padding: 0.9951).

Embedding sabotage (P03) feeds inputs_embeds: the token ids are unchanged, but the input-embedding rows looked up for some positions are replaced before floor 1. The model has tied embeddings (tie_word_embeddings=True; the output head IS the same 151936 x 896 matrix), and only the INPUT lookup is changed: the output head that turns the last hidden state into scores is untouched.

scramble-*: chat markers stay intact: positions labeled 'special' (<|im_start|>, role names, the newline after them, <|im_end|>, the <tool_response> wrappers) and every added token (ids >= 151643, e.g. <tool_call>, </tool_call>) are never scrambled. That leaves 289 of the 327 context positions. numpy default_rng(20261015) draws one uniform u[pos] and one replacement id repl[pos] in 0..151642 (ordinary tokens only, so no chat marker is injected) for every position. In the context, the round(f x 289) content positions with the smallest u are scrambled: scramble-10 29 (f=0.10), scramble-50 144 (f=0.50), scramble-100 289 (f=1.00). From pos 327 on (generated tokens fed back during greedy, or the recorded reply in the teacher-forced pass) a content position is scrambled when u[pos] < f. A scrambled position gets the row of repl[pos] (or repl[pos] + 1 if that is the token itself). The sets are nested: every position scrambled at 10% is also scrambled at 50% and 100%, with the same replacement.

swap-flour-sugar: every position whose token is ' flour' (id 19828; 2 in the context: pos 34 (rag), pos 258 (user), plus any generated or recorded ' flour' fed back) gets the input row of ' sugar' (id 13163). Token ids are unchanged. wordProb is the teacher-forced P(' flour') for the recorded reply's pos 336 (hidden state at pos 335, after '... cups of'), softmax over the 151665 real rows, with the top 3 there.

Attention sabotage (P04): an additive 4D mask [1, 1, T, T] (0 = may look, float32 min = blocked) is passed to the model with attn_implementation='eager'; transformers uses a 4D mask as-is and adds it to the scores before the softmax, in all 24 floors and all 14 heads. The mask includes the causal rule (no looking ahead). hide-card: a query that is not a 'rag' token (everything outside the two passages and their 'Your files:' header: the rest of the system message, the tool definitions, the question, the tool call, the result, the reply) may not look at any 'rag' token (pos 9-83, 75 tokens); the passages still see each other. hide-result: every query after the last 'res' token (pos > 316) may not look at the 'res' tokens pos 311-316 (the calculator's 8.4375); the wrappers around them stay visible. self-only: every token looks only at itself (the diagonal), so attention mixes in nothing from other tokens. Check: the plain causal rule as a 4D mask reproduces the unmasked run to max |logit difference| 0.0e+00.

Stack sabotage (P05): use_cache=False; model.model.layers is temporarily replaced with a ModuleList of the kept floors, so a skipped floor's residual stream passes through unchanged. The final RMSNorm and the (tied) output head still run after the last kept floor; token positions and rotary embeddings are unchanged. Floors are numbered 1..24 (floor k = model.model.layers[k-1]). skip-mid drops floor 12, skip-first drops floor 1, top-half-gone keeps floors 1-12, stop-18 keeps floors 1-18. skipEach[k-1].prob is the teacher-forced P('8') at pos 331 with only floor k skipped. Check: running with all 24 floors through the same swap gives max |hidden difference| 0.0e+00.
Check: feeding inputs_embeds (the plain lookup) instead of input_ids changes no logit by more than 0.0e+00.

Stop token (P08): no-stop starts from the shared context with nothing else changed, but at every greedy step the scores of both EOS ids, <|im_end|> (id 151645) and <|endoftext|> (id 151643), are set to -inf before the argmax, so the reply cannot end by itself and runs for the full 80 new tokens (stoppedNaturally = false; every other run is capped at 40). Its first 28 new tokens are the normal run's whole reply, token for token; where the normal run then stopped, no-stop carries on with its best token that is not a stop token. rightDigit and wordProb come from the usual teacher-forced pass over the recorded reply with the same two ids set to -inf before the softmax; the recorded '8' and ' flour' are not EOS, so this only renormalizes (P('8'): normal 0.9951, no-stop 0.9951). Its 80 new tokens contain no other special or added token.

stopProb: in the normal (unsabotaged) teacher-forced pass over hero tokens 0..343, P('<|im_end|>') for pos 344, read from the hidden state at pos 343 (the recorded reply's final '.'), softmax at T=1 over the 151665 real vocab rows, with the top 3 there: 0.9737 (hero-trace.json, softmax over all 151936 rows incl. padding: 0.9737). It is the model's own chance of ending the reply right there; no-stop takes that choice away.

Content screen: every greedy text, every top-3 token and every flourNeighbors word was checked with scripts/trace/screen.py (a superset of src/lib/safeText.ts). Greedy cannot be redrawn, so a hit keeps its record and sets "flagged": true. Nothing was flagged.
